# Template functions

<!-- Generated by `go generate ./internal/funcs` from internal/funcs/doc.go. Do not edit. -->

tmplforge adds 36 functions to the text/template builtins
(and, or, not, len, index, slice, printf, eq, lt, ...). Functions take
their subject argument last so they compose in pipelines:
`{{ .name | default "world" | upper }}`.

`funcs.Safe()` (used by `render -sandbox` and the web GUI) is
`funcs.All()` minus the functions marked "no" in the Safe column.

| Function | Signature | Safe | Description | Example | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `dict` | `dict k1 v1 [k2 v2 ...] map` | yes | Build a map from alternating string keys and values. | `{{ (dict "a" 1).a }}` | `1` |
| `list` | `list v... []any` | yes | Build a list from its arguments. | `{{ list 1 2 3 }}` | `[1 2 3]` |
| `default` | `default d v any` | yes | Return v, or d when v is empty (zero, "", nil, empty list/map). | `{{ "" \| default "x" }}` | `x` |
| `coalesce` | `coalesce v... any` | yes | Return the first non-empty argument. | `{{ coalesce "" 0 "z" }}` | `z` |
| `ternary` | `ternary a b cond any` | yes | Return a if cond, else b. | `{{ true \| ternary "y" "n" }}` | `y` |
| `join` | `join sep list string` | yes | Join list elements (stringified) with sep. | `{{ list "a" "b" \| join "," }}` | `a,b` |
| `split` | `split sep s []string` | yes | Split s on sep. | `{{ split "," "a,b" }}` | `[a b]` |
| `upper` | `upper s string` | yes | Upper-case s. | `{{ "go" \| upper }}` | `GO` |
| `lower` | `lower s string` | yes | Lower-case s. | `{{ "GO" \| lower }}` | `go` |
| `trim` | `trim s string` | yes | Trim leading and trailing white space. | `{{ "  x " \| trim }}` | `x` |
| `replace` | `replace old new s string` | yes | Replace every old with new in s. | `{{ "a-b" \| replace "-" "_" }}` | `a_b` |
| `repeat` | `repeat n s string` | yes | Repeat s n times (result capped at 1 MiB). | `{{ "ab" \| repeat 2 }}` | `abab` |
| `indent` | `indent n s string` | yes | Indent every non-empty line of s by n spaces. | `{{ "a" \| indent 2 }}` | `  a` |
| `nindent` | `nindent n s string` | yes | Like indent, with a leading newline. | `{{ "a" \| nindent 2 }}` | `\n  a` |
| `plural` | `plural one many n string` | yes | Choose one if n == 1, else many. | `{{ 2 \| plural "file" "files" }}` | `files` |
| `add` | `add a b int` | yes | Integer sum. | `{{ add 1 2 }}` | `3` |
| `sub` | `sub a b int` | yes | Integer difference a-b. | `{{ sub 5 2 }}` | `3` |
| `mul` | `mul a b int` | yes | Integer product. | `{{ mul 2 3 }}` | `6` |
| `div` | `div a b int` | yes | Integer quotient; error on zero. | `{{ div 7 2 }}` | `3` |
| `mod` | `mod a b int` | yes | Integer remainder; error on zero. | `{{ mod 7 2 }}` | `1` |
| `seq` | `seq [lo] hi iter.Seq[int]` | yes | Lazy sequence lo..hi (lo defaults to 1) for range; one range variable only (an iter.Seq, so a huge range costs time, not memory). | `{{ range seq 3 }}{{ . }}{{ end }}` | `123` |
| `sortedKeys` | `sortedKeys m []string` | yes | Map keys in sorted order: deterministic map iteration. | `{{ sortedKeys (dict "b" 1 "a" 2) }}` | `[a b]` |
| `toJSON` | `toJSON v string` | yes | Compact JSON encoding. | `{{ dict "a" 1 \| toJSON }}` | `{"a":1}` |
| `toPrettyJSON` | `toPrettyJSON v string` | yes | Two-space-indented JSON encoding. | `{{ list 1 \| toPrettyJSON }}` | `[\n  1\n]` |
| `fromJSON` | `fromJSON s any` | yes | Decode JSON; integral numbers become int. | `{{ (fromJSON "{\"n\":2}").n }}` | `2` |
| `toYAML` | `toYAML v string` | yes | Block-style YAML with sorted keys (stdlib emitter). | `{{ dict "a" 1 \| toYAML }}` | `a: 1` |
| `b64enc` | `b64enc s string` | yes | Standard base64 encoding. | `{{ "hi" \| b64enc }}` | `aGk=` |
| `b64dec` | `b64dec s string` | yes | Standard base64 decoding. | `{{ "aGk=" \| b64dec }}` | `hi` |
| `sha256sum` | `sha256sum s string` | yes | Hex SHA-256 of s. | `{{ "" \| sha256sum }}` | `e3b0c442...b855` |
| `now` | `now time.Time` | yes | Current UTC time; honours SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH for reproducible output. | `{{ now.Year }}` | `2026` |
| `dateFmt` | `dateFmt layout t string` | yes | Format a time, RFC 3339 / YYYY-MM-DD string or Unix seconds with a Go layout. | `{{ dateFmt "Jan 2" "2026-10-19" }}` | `Oct 19` |
| `regexMatch` | `regexMatch re s bool` | yes | RE2 match (pattern capped at 1 KiB). | `{{ regexMatch "^v[0-9]" "v1" }}` | `true` |
| `regexReplaceAll` | `regexReplaceAll re repl s string` | yes | RE2 replace-all; repl may use $1. | `{{ regexReplaceAll "o+" "0" "foo" }}` | `f0` |
| `shq` | `shq s string` | yes | Single-quote s for a POSIX shell. | `{{ "it's" \| shq }}` | `'it'\''s'` |
| `env` | `env name string` | no | Environment variable. **Not in Safe()**. | `{{ env "HOME" }}` | `/home/glenda` |
| `file` | `file path string` | no | Read a file (capped at 1 MiB). **Not in Safe()**. | `{{ file "VERSION" }}` | `1.0.0` |
